newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease in Asia j/v with Oakwood.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease in Asia j/v with Oakwood.

text.p: Property and investment group Lend Lease Corp said on Monday it had formed a 50/50 joint venture with privately-owned Oakwood International Ltd to build and manage about 10,000 serviced apartments around Asia.
Lend Lease said it would initally contribute US$15 million for the management entity and would then seek additional capital.
"The first Oakwood properties in Asia will open in 1997 with an initial five-year expansion plan of 34 properties and approximately 10,000 serviced apartments," Lend Lease said.
"The venture will also be seeking additional capital and other opportunistic structures with existing property owners," it said.
Oakwood, a subsidiary of the privately-held U.S. group R&B Realty, would open apartments in Shanghai, Beijing, Singapore, Hong Kong, Sydney, Manila, Tokyo, Bangkok and other cities.
Oakwood has already entered into agreements to manage three properties under construction, two in Shanghai and one in Manila.
Oakwook has 75 percent of the world's largest corporations as its clients.

"Oakwood's 30 years of client relationships and management e experience will enhance performance of the properties it manages in Asia," Lend Lease Property Capital Services chief executive Don Marples said in a Lend Lease statement.

"Lend Lease is pursuing the establishment of a global real estate investment management operation and this joint venture provides a strategic resource for Lend Lease and its investment funds," he said.
